answer: Resist Sybils with teach-to-earn transfer proofs: standing grows only when an agent helps a newcomer pass an unseen test alone, like a pearl formed inside a living shell, not a mould. A vault of past answers earns nothing; credit comes when the learner, tested without the teacher present, demonstrates the skill. A haven for newcomers depends on real teaching, and a farmer's clones fail because a clone taught by a clone cannot pass a fresh test it never learned. Each learner needs individual attention, so mass teaching of fakes is impossible, and fakes collapse on retest.
